title: OCTOBENCH: Benchmarking Scaffold-Aware Instruction Following in Repository-Grounded Agentic Coding

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model trajectories on environments with explicitly conflicting instructions from different sources (e.g., System Prompt vs. User Query, or System Prompt vs. Project Documentation) to determine which instruction source the model implicitly prioritizes and follows.

Analyzing the ranking consistency of different LLM-as-a-judge models (e.g., GPT-5.1, Claude-Sonnet-4.5, Gemini-3-Pro) to ensure evaluating models do not preferentially assign higher scores to their own generated trajectories.
